categories.name: Administration
categories.description: Server configuration, security auditing, management tools, and administrative overrides.

commands.name: adminrole
commands.description: Configures or displays authorized administrative/bot developer roles for the bot override system.

commands.name: mediaonly
commands.description: Toggles an automated enforcement lock on a channel restricting text-only messages.

commands.name: permaudit
commands.description: Runs a structural check on server permissions to detect hazardous configuration flaws.

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Bulk deletes messages matching standard filters from the current channel.

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Updates a member's server nickname or targets channel name profiles cleanly.

commands.name: role
commands.description: Utility system to add, remove, strip, or audit user role updates.

commands.name: setuplog
commands.description: Initializes or updates the text channel endpoint map for target mod logs.

commands.name: sticky
commands.description: Pins an explicit message block to the absolute bottom of a text chat channel loop.
examples: sticky Read the rules before typing

commands.name: verification
commands.description: Links the core verified role database entry used by the verification gates.

commands.name: whois
commands.description: Generates a detailed profile inspection layout displaying join metrics, IDs, and roles.

categories.name: Channel Management
categories.description: Commands to adjust accessibility, clean up context visibility, or lock chats.

commands.name: hide
commands.description: Alters channel permissions to instantly mask or reveal it to the @everyone level.

commands.name: lockdown
commands.description: Freezes message execution updates across a single targeted channel structure or lifts it.

categories.name: Moderation
categories.description: Core punitive tracking systems used by the safety team to maintain server balance.

commands.name: ban
commands.description: Permanently seals a member out of the guild space and triggers mod log dispatch.

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Removes a member from the server safely while shooting an embed notice to their DMs.

commands.name: tempban
commands.description: Applies a temporary constraint loop on a user via a dedicated isolation role configuration.

commands.name: timeout
commands.description: Enforces a strict native communications restriction timeline lock on a target.

categories.name: General Utility
categories.description: Standard user actions, configuration components, and metadata readers.

commands.name: afk
commands.description: Caches an AFK status block to automatically trigger back-references when tagged by users.

commands.name: afk reset
commands.description: Administratively forces clearance of a target user's active AFK state parameters.

commands.name: avatar
commands.description: Generates a clear image embed block isolating a target user's current avatar graphic.

commands.name: banner
commands.description: Extracts and displays a profile banner asset block from a targeted account.

commands.name: fuck
commands.description: High-intensity meme or explicit response script utility.

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Measures and prints current heartbeat connection latency to the Discord gateway.

commands.name: serverinfo
commands.description: Generates a clean dashboard summary isolating vanity levels, booster data, and member tallies.

commands.name: shards
commands.description: Audits internal cluster configurations showing ping levels and state indices for diagnostic validation.

commands.name: steal
commands.description: Copies a raw external custom emoji payload directly down into the local guild assets list.

categories.name: Voice Management
categories.description: Voice configuration actions used to manipulate room structures or connections.

commands.name: drag
commands.description: Pulls a specific target member forcefully from another audio lounge directly into yours.

commands.name: moveall
commands.description: Migrates every active speaker inside your current session directly into a targeted alternative room.

categories.name: System Help
categories.description: Hybrid commands usable across prefix styles and slash entry formats alike.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Launches the interactive modular interface menu reading data directly out of this system layout mapping.
